$comment: Machine-readable inter-framework articulation map, owned by the `it` domain framework (the integrator). Reference frameworks are isolated and never encode these relations in their schemas; composition happens here and through GSM governance (Directives/Norms qualifying subjects across frameworks). The prose analysis in frameworks/README.md is derived commentary; this file is the authoritative articulation declaration. Relations: qualifies-with (Directive qualifier from other framework), measures-with (Norm assertions reference other framework's property vocabulary), governed-by (subjects governed by other framework's quality/regulatory dimensions), identified-by (identification substrate), parallel-obligation (independent regulatory chains on the same event), distinct-overlap (related dimensions, deliberately separate scopes), composes-facet (schema-level allOf composition of a rootless facet — the only schema-level cross-framework mechanism, reserved to the domain layer).

articulations.summary: Anticipated coupling: ITIP runtime registration archetypes compose the prov ProvAttribution facet (wasAttributedTo) so tenant-authored statements carry platform-derived authorship for ownership-based access checks.

Domain-layer articulation: PROV leaves wasAttributedTo.agent open; the composing it-layer archetype tightens it to the oidc OidcSubject shape (sub, iss), so the attributed agent is OIDC-identified. Neither reference framework encodes this — the coupling exists only here.
SoftwareTechnology composes ScapPlatformIdentifier as a rootless facet: CPE URI plus decomposed attributes identify what technology platform an IT subject is.
TOGAF governance mechanisms provide governance intent; ISO 2501x archetypes provide the measurement vocabulary.

conceptMappings.note: Any ISO 25010 product-quality characteristic may serve as qualifier.
Specific quality characteristic plus measurable threshold.
ISO 25012 inherent data-quality characteristics govern TOGAF data architecture subjects.
ISO 25011 service-quality characteristics govern TOGAF service subjects.

articulations.summary: ISO 25010 (product), ISO 25011 (service), and ISO 25012 (data) are complementary internal models: product quality governs system behavior, service quality governs delivery experience, data quality governs intrinsic/systemic data properties.

conceptMappings.note: Artifact intrinsic quality vs delivery experience (SLA).

articulations.summary: NIS2 creates the legal obligation; ISO 2501x provides the measurement vocabulary its Norms assert against.

conceptMappings.note: Art 21(2)(h) cryptography and 21(2)(j) MFA verified through ProductSecurity properties.
Legal deadlines (24h/72h/1mo) are not SLA targets.

articulations.summary: NIS2 Directives are the legal root; TOGAF principles, standards, and requirements derive architecture decisions from the regulatory mandates.

conceptMappings.note: Entity tier is a scoping input to capability mapping.

articulations.summary: SCAP is the identification substrate for NIS2 compliance evidence: CPE scopes platforms, CCE identifies the configuration settings that Norm assertions check.
Complementary EU regulations with orthogonal scoping (GDPR: controller/processor role; NIS2: entity tier). Both chains activate independently on the same event.

conceptMappings.note: GDPR 72h to DPA; NIS2 24h/72h/1mo to CSIRT — both satisfied independently.

articulations.summary: GDPR principles create the legal obligation; ISO 2501x provides measurement properties, notably ISO 25012 for the data-quality principles.
GDPR Directives are the legal root for data-protection governance; TOGAF translates them into architecture principles, requirements, and standards.
SCAP CPE provides the standardized identification scheme for TOGAF technology-architecture subjects.
SCAP identifies the technology targets and configuration settings that ISO 25010 ProductSecurity measures are evaluated against.
